title: Let agents tidy my inbox
help: Choose whether the agents you manage may archive tasks out of your inbox on your behalf. You can undo any archive, and every agent archive is attributed in the task's properties.
anyHelp: Let any agent you manage archive tasks out of your inbox.
chosenHelp: Restrict inbox tidying to the agents you pick below.
offHelp: Agents can never archive tasks from your inbox.
allowed: Agents allowed to tidy my inbox
noAgents: You don’t manage any agents yet.
loadFailed: Failed to load inbox agent policy.
saveFailed: Failed to save inbox agent policy.
noCompany: Select an organization to manage inbox agent archiving.
